# yellowdog_application (Resource)

Represents a user application within the YellowDog Platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An application is a non-human identity with its own API key and secret, for
# programs that call the YellowDog API.
resource "yellowdog_application" "example" {
  name        = "example-application"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
}

# api_key and api_secret are returned only once, when the application is
# created. Store them somewhere durable, such as a secret manager, if you need
# them later -- `terraform import` cannot recover them.
output "example_api_key" {
  value     = yellowdog_application.example.api_key
  sensitive = true
}

output "example_api_secret" {
  value     = yellowdog_application.example.api_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The Application's API key
- `api_secret` (String, Sensitive) The application's API secret (only returned by the API at creation time)
- `created_by_user_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the application's YDID. api_key and api_secret are null after
# import, as the API returns them only when the application is created.
terraform import yellowdog_application.example ydid:app:000000:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
